# Velair 1.9.3-beta.2

This beta adds optional Room Assist braking to withdraw heating or cooling demand more firmly around the scheduled target. Default preserves the existing regulation.

## ✨ Added

- Choose **Moderate** braking at the existing hysteresis limit, or **High** braking from the scheduled target. Both require a positive Room Assist deadband and use fixed, step-aligned setpoint limits without accumulating adjustments. Available in fixed Heat and Cool, including two-setpoint devices with a configured reference. Thanks to @AilleryC for suggesting [#61](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/61).
- Room Assist live status and the shared temperature graph show braking and demand-resumption thresholds. Supply control follows the same committed demand state.

## 🧭 Notes

- This prerelease follows [1.9.3-beta.1](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/releases/tag/v1.9.3-beta.1). Existing installations keep **Default** unless another braking level is selected.
